inputs.text: Vertical medium close shot of the same adult Chinese woman seated at the wooden desk. She looks downward at one smartphone held below chest height; only the matte rear shell and camera module face the camera, while its display is fully hidden. Her free right hand rests tensely on the desk with naturally curled fingers, never touching the phone screen. Her worried adult plush face is unobstructed in three-quarter view, same low ponytail, light blue shirt, charcoal blazer and thin silver necklace. Premium handcrafted 3D plush stop-motion film, cold tense lighting, shallow depth of field. Exactly one phone, rear side only, no visible screen, no interface, no tapping, natural hands, no generated text.
